name: Shakti arm of Tsang 2004 with coil polarity (amygdala left, LTP right, 30 min)
origin: Todd Murphy (Shakti, sound-card driven); tested by Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2004
summary: The Shakti arm of Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2004, rebuilt with the vendor's coil polarity: three coils per side, burst-firing on the left and the primed burst on the right at the same time, 30 min in three weekly sessions. The paper reports no treatment differences in delta, theta, low alpha, beta or gamma, and one high-alpha interaction it ascribes mainly to Shakti (4 people per arm).
notes: Tsang 2004: a modified bicycle helmet with three sets of solenoids at the level of the prefrontal, parietal and temporal lobes. The left side delivered the burst-firing pattern, the right side 'one pulse followed 170 ms later by four high frequency pulses about 3.8 times per sec', 'delivered once every 4.76 s' (p.5 [1017]). Both signals are rebuilt: the vendor's files are not published. Left: the project's rising sweep, 230 points of 3 ms, once every 4 s (the paper states no repeat interval); its point values were never published as numbers. Right: one pulse, then four pulses 170 ms later, three times in 0.74 s (after p.5 [1017]), once every 4.76 s. The 2-ms pulse width, the 10-ms spacing and the three bursts per presentation are this project's choices. Polarity (temporal coil positive, frontal and parietal reversed) is taken from the vendor's comparison page; the paper is silent on it, and the parietal sign is a guess. F3, T7, P3 and F4, T8, P4 are this project's reading; 'prefrontal' points further forward than F3. The paper gives about 1 uT (10 mG) near the surface of the scalp on the left and about 0.5 uT (5 mG) on the right, instrument not stated (p.5-6 [1017-1018]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. 1 uT there is about 24 uT at the scalp, 24 times the paper's left value; the right side plays at half the left level. Support: 4 people per arm (p.3 [1015]); the Shakti result is the one significant term among eight treatment terms in six bands (Table 1, p.7 [1019]). One lab. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). The lab's own arm is persinger-koren-boxes-tsang-2004; the third arm is sham. Not for anyone with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop on headache, nausea or distress.
setting: Seated or reclined, eyes closed, in a quiet, dark room. Record EEG before each session to compare with the paper.
schedule: 30 min once a week for three weeks; the lab recorded EEG before each session.
source: Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2004, Int J Neurosci 114:1013 (Shakti vs Koren boxes) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15527205/ ; Murphy, Shakti Spiritual Technology & Koren Helmet - A Comparison https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/koren_shakti.htm ; Corradini 2014, MA thesis, Laurentian University (primed-burst LTP file) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/1455e1f3-2f1d-47b5-93cd-23713d69e651 ; Delparte & Persinger 2007, Int J Neurosci 117:295 ('1 s pulse of 5 trains') https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17365115/ ; Persinger 2010, NeuroQuantology 8(4):444 (the LTP pattern: a primer then 4 pulses about 170 ms later at 100-200 Hz) http://web.archive.org/web/20150426091303id_/http://www.neuroquantology.com/index.php/journal/article/download/301/346 ; Carniello 2020, PhD thesis, Laurentian University (230-point burst-firing file, 3 ms) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/8c92763c-cd19-4a21-b242-3b572a28ce55 ; Martin, Koren & Persinger 2004, Int J Neurosci 114:1259 (.wav through a coil worked, compact disc did not) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15370185/ ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
